Watch the delightful video of the song sung by talented Vishal Dadlani starring Bollywood’s favorite threesome, Priyanka, John and Abhishek. This video is sure to make you smile thinking about your own moments spent with those special ones you just can’t do without!
Song Name - Jaane Kyun
Movie - Dostana
Singer - Vishal Dadlani
Lyrics - Anvita Dutt
Music - Vishal & Shekhar
Director - Tarun Mansukhani
Studio - Dharma Productions Pvt. Ltd.
